I'm extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Van Heusen. I purchased two women's blazers, but the store staff made a grave error by putting the wrong name on the bill despite me spelling out my name clearly. To make matters worse, they claimed to have updated my name in their system, but it would take 24 hours to reflect. When I called the store the next day, they informed me that they would have to cancel the bill and create a new one with the correct name. This lack of attention to detail and inefficient process is frustrating.

Rating Breakdown

Product Quality: 4/5 (The blazers themselves were great, but that's not enough to redeem the poor service)
Customer Service:1/5 (The staff's handling of the billing issue was unacceptable)

Overall Experience:2/5 (A disappointing experience that could have been improved with better service)

Recommendation: Van Heusen needs to work on their billing process and staff training to ensure accurate and efficient service. Until then, customers like me may face similar frustrations. If you're a fan of Van Heusen's products, I'd suggest being prepared for potential issues or considering online purchases where possible.
